title: Gemini in Google Chat
description: This course covers how to use Gemini in Google Chat to streamline business messaging. Learn to cut through notification noise with summaries, use natural language search to locate buried decisions, and refine message tone with real-time writing tools. Explore other content in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) program.

title: Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits
description: Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits empowers nonprofit professionals to reclaim time for their mission by integrating Generative AI into daily workflows. In this course, you will learn a proven prompting framework (Persona, Task, Context, Format) to utilize with AI assistants to help you discover and synthesize information. You will learn how to identify which daily tasks are right for AI augmentation, and which are not. Built on a foundation of responsible AI use, this course is designed to help you achieve a dual return-on-investment (ROI) by reclaiming hours from repetitive administrative tasks and reinvesting that recovered capacity into high-value, mission-driven work.

title: Welcome to the AI for Nonprofits Course Series
description: Throughout the AI for Nonprofits course series, you will leverage Generative AI as a helpful assistant to reclaim time from routine tasks and unlock the strategic capacity required for deeper, mission-driven work. Learn more about the series in this welcome video.

title: Optimize Creativity and Fundraising with AI for Nonprofits
description: This course teaches nonprofit professionals how to utilize AI to help create marketing assets and improve fundraising workflows. While building on Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits, this course will help you design custom AI experts to help you with repetitive tasks like donor outreach and brand-voice editing. Through source-grounding, you will generate data-driven insights strictly based on your own workplace files. This course aims to empower you to maintain quality control across various AI-generated media types.

title: Build Smarter Workflows with AI for Nonprofits
description: Building on the foundational workflows established in Daily Wins with AI for Nonprofits and the creative strategies from Optimize Creativity and Fundraising with AI, this course teaches you to automate complex administrative tasks using source-grounded AI. You will learn to transform unstructured data, such as meeting audio and siloed reports, into structured assets like project briefs and compliance checklists. By restricting AI responses strictly to your workplace files, you will maintain data integrity and minimize the risk of hallucinations. Finally, you will apply the ACT Framework to draft a personal AI use policy, ensuring  these AI experiences  remain ethical and mission-aligned.

title: Orchestrate Workflows with the Data Agent Kit
description:
This course brings AI-driven, natural-language data engineering into the IDE and CLI workflows you already use. Built on the Agent Development Kit (ADK), the Data Agent Kit connects to a wide array of Google Cloud services, including BigQuery, Spanner, BigLake, Dataproc, and Managed Airflow. By using it, you can collapse days of pipeline scaffolding, data build tool (dbt) authoring, and orchestration wiring into prompt-driven sessions.
As an intermediate-to-advanced practitioner, you will learn to build a data agent with the Agent Development Kit (ADK). You'll wire up the Model Context Protocol (MCP) layer, and use your agent to explore catalogs, transform data, train models, and orchestrate scheduled pipelines on Google Cloud.

title: Set Up Multiple Network Interfaces
description: Learn how to securely bridge isolated Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networks without compromising strict internal security boundaries. Step into real-world engineering scenarios to explore multi-interface virtual machines, standard vNIC configurations, and temporary Dynamic NIC deployments for live forensic analysis.

title: Configure VPC Routes and Addresses
description: In this course, you'll learn to manage advanced networking configurations within a Google Cloud virtual private cloud (VPC) network. The course focuses on three critical pillars of modern infrastructure: IPv6 adoption, intelligent traffic routing, and IP address portability.

title: Critical Thinking in AI-Driven Workflows
description:
In a world where AI can generate ideas in seconds, true innovation now lies in the uniquely human ability to think critically. This course explores the dynamic intersection of human ingenuity and machine intelligence, shifting the human role from simply producing quick answers to exercising high-level judgment.  

Through hands-on interactivities and real-world simulations, you'll move beyond treating AI as a mere shortcut and learn to use it as a strategic thinking partner. You'll develop the skills necessary to handle the polished imperfection of AI outputs by refining, challenging, and verifying information to transform generic results into professional, high-impact assets that you can confidently own.

title: Simplify Your Architecture with Network Connectivity Center
description: Learn how to simplify and scale global connectivity across diverse cloud and hybrid networks. Step into real-world engineering scenarios to explore Network Connectivity Center (NCC) topologies, standard and hybrid spoke attachments, and Private NAT configurations for resolving overlapping IP address conflicts.

title: Build Agent Skills with Google
description: Close the gap between general AI capabilities and your domain knowledge through Agent Skills. This course walks you through the full lifecycle of custom skill building, from local scaffolding and testing to enterprise scaling and sharing using Google's agent ecosystem, including Google Antigravity, ADK, and Skill Registry. Additionally, you use Google Agents CLI toolkit to attach skills to standalone 24/7 cloud agents, equipping your team with reliable, autonomous digital coworkers.

title: Build Collaborative Multi-Agent Systems with ADK & MCP
description: Learn to design, coordinate, and deploy multi-agent systems using Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Using a travel concierge example, you'll learn to orchestrate a network of specialized agents with custom guardrails. By the end of the course, you'll understand the design patterns and deployment strategies required for robust, scalable AI workflows.  Explore other content in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) program.

title: Google DeepMind : 08 Capstone: Develop Your Model for Real-World Impact
description: In this Google DeepMind course, you will complete a capstone project that brings together the technical knowledge, ethical awareness, and creative problem-solving skills that you have developed throughout the Google DeepMind: AI Research Foundations curriculum. You will apply what you have learned to a problem of your choosing. You will first plan your project to ensure that you are clear on your project aims and intended impact. You will then collect and prepare data for your model. Finally, you will implement a full fine-tuning workflow using Gemma 3 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and evaluate its performance. You will receive guidance, but the emphasis will be on adaptation and experimentation - skills that are essential for applied AI research.

title: Build a Certification Study Guide: ADP Exam Prep
description:
Use Gemini Notebook to create a personalized study guide for the Associate Data Practitioner certification exam.  

You'll review Gemini Notebook features, create a notebook with Gemini Notebook, and use the study guide to practice for a certification exam.

title: Secure Enterprise AI Agents
description: Learn how to secure and govern AI agents on Google Cloud. This course provides a practical roadmap to securing agent memory, enforcing strict access controls with IAM and VPC Service Controls, and deploying real-time conversation guardrails to ensure safe, compliant enterprise deployments. Explore other content in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) program.

title: Google Cloud Agent Governance and Security
description: As enterprise teams transition to autonomous AI agents, security evolves toward proactive, identity-centric protection. In this course, you will implement a zero-trust security architecture for Cymbal Banking's underwriting platform using the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. By deploying a regional Egress Agent Gateway, configuring Model Armor and Semantic Governance (SGP) safety templates, assigning cryptographic SPIFFE identities to agent runtimes, and declaring a VPC-SC perimeter in Terraform, you will protect database boundaries and manage tools with production-grade governance.

title: AI Boost Bites: Create ‘What If’ Scenarios with AI
description: In this video, you'll learn to create "what if" scenarios using AI's reasoning. You'll see how to set a "before" scene with a person holding a cake, prompt an action by asking "what would happen if they tripped?", and let the AI generate the plausible "after" image of the cake falling.

title: Gemini in Google Workspace Studio
description: This course aims to empower Google Workspace users to efficiently automate cross-application tasks, significantly boosting productivity and streamlining daily operations. Learners will gain practical skills in designing and configuring automations as well as customizing steps in Google Workspace Studio.

title: AI Boost Bites: The Seller's AI Data Analyst
description: This video covers how to upload customer usage spreadsheets to Gemini and use natural language prompts to identify adoption trends and specific upsell opportunities.

title: AI Boost Bites: The Expert Scaler
description: This video covers how to build a Strategic Challenger Gem to stress-test your initiatives. You'll learn a framework to force friction and evaluate ideas across multiple stakeholder perspectives before presenting them.

title: AI Boost Bites: From Raw Data to Slides
description: This video covers a step-by-step workspace AI flow to turn raw documents into a presentation draft. You'll see how to combine Gemini Notebook, Custom Gems, and Google Vids to quickly synthesize data, draft slide copy, and build a compelling narrative.

title: AI Boost Bites: Win Pitches with Gemini Notebook
description: This video covers how to use Gemini Notebook as a personal sales consultant to synthesize massive collections of client documents into clear, winning pitches and on-demand Q&A guides.

title: AI Boost Bites: Brand Enforcer
description: This video covers how to use Agent Designer in Gemini Enterprise to build a custom Brand Checker agent that audits content and images for compliance.

title: AI Boost Bites: Intro to Gemini Enterprise
description: This video covers the fundamentals of Gemini Enterprise, demonstrating how to use the admin console, connect external databases, and deploy custom, no-code AI agents.

title: AI Boost Bites: Generate the Perfect Audio Track
description: This video covers how to use Gemini's audio generation capabilities to compose custom, royalty-free audio and soundtrack files for your marketing videos and social posts.

title: AI Boost Bites: Master the ABCDQ of Prompting
description: This video covers the five essential ingredients of the ABCDQ prompting framework, showing you how to craft clear, highly accurate prompts to get the absolute best results from Gemini.

title: AI Boost Bites: Automate Marketing Workflows
description: This video covers how to build no-code automations in Google Workspace Studio that bridge communication gaps between global operations and regional execution teams.

title: AI Boost Bites: Design Strategy Presentations
description: This video covers how to use Gemini Canvas to generate a slide deck from a campaign brief, and how to leverage Google Slides' generative design features to create custom visuals and timelines.

title: AI Boost Bites: Create Product Videos with Vids
description: This video covers how to use Google Vids to transform presentation decks into fully animated product overview videos, complete with AI voiceovers and Veo-generated motion clips.

title: AI Boost Bites: Create Better Campaign Briefs
description: This video covers how to use Gemini Canvas to synthesize meeting notes, performance data, and surveys from Google Drive into a structured campaign brief, and how to export it to Google Docs for collaborative editing.

title: AI Boost Bites: Turn One Asset into a Campaign
description: This video covers how to use Gemini in Docs to multiply a single whitepaper or PDF into a comprehensive suite of marketing assets - from landing pages and LinkedIn posts to email nurtures.

title: AI Boost Bites: Build a Campaign Project Tracker
description: This video covers how to use the Gemini side panel in Google Sheets to import unstructured meeting notes from Drive and automatically generate a unified, status-tracked project roadmap.

title: AI Boost Bites: Master Your Meetings with Gemini
description: This video covers how to use Gemini features like "Help me schedule," "Take notes for me," and automatic meeting summaries to streamline scheduling, participation, and post-meeting follow-up.

title: AI Boost Bites: Build a Branded Knowledge Base
description: This video covers how to use Gemini Notebook's customization features, specifically custom cover images and welcome summaries, to professionalize and brand your shared notebooks for teams and public distribution.

title: AI Boost Bites: Google Workspace Studio
description: This video covers how to use Google Workspace Studio to build AI agents using "Starters," "Steps," and "Variables" to automate workflows without writing code.

title: AI Boost Bites: Master Internal Comms in Gmail
description: This video covers how to use Gemini in Gmail to draft announcements, refine the tone of your message, and generate context-aware replies that match your personal writing style.

title: AI Boost Bites: The Project Coordinator's Command Center
description: This video covers how to use Gemini in Gmail to summarize meeting threads, draft action plans using Drive references, and schedule events directly from email text.

title: AI Boost Bites: Your AI-Powered Career Coach
description: AI Boost Bites is a video series designed to help you leverage Google's AI tools in your daily work. Each episode, under 10 minutes, features a quick video demonstrating a real-world AI use case or topic. After the video, you'll get a challenge to apply what you've learned. title: Introduction to the Gemini App
description: This training aims to empower Google Workspace users to seamlessly integrate the Gemini app, securely accessing their data to unlock new levels of productivity. Learners will learn how to leverage Gemini's capabilities to enhance creativity and accelerate problem-solving for complex business challenges.

title: AI Infrastructure: Orchestration and Automation
description: This course covers the automation and operational management of GKE clusters optimized for distributed AI and machine learning workloads. You will learn to provision accelerator resources, configure advanced workload queueing, mitigate capacity constraints, and orchestrate large-scale distributed jobs.

title: Build a Certification Study Guide: AGWA Exam Prep
description: This on-demand course teaches learners how to use Gemini Notebook to create effective and structured study guides for the Associate Google Workspace Administrator (AGWA) certification exam. Learners will gain hands-on experience extracting key concepts from official Google Workspace documentation, formulating tailored prompts for custom study questions and flashcards, and organizing study materials into dedicated Gemini Notebook workspaces.

title: Data Analysis with AI for Nonprofits
description: Data Analysis with AI for Nonprofits empowers nonprofit professionals to transform unorganized data into clear, actionable insights. In this course, you will learn how to leverage multimodal AI to quickly clean, structure, and standardize unstructured operational records, from scanned paper sign-in sheets to inconsistent donor spreadsheets. You will discover how to use natural language prompting to perform sentiment analysis, run strategic what-if scenarios with interactive impact simulators, and build informative data visualizations that resonate with key stakeholders. Built on a foundation of responsible data governance, this course helps you achieve a dual return-on-investment (ROI): reclaiming critical hours lost to manual spreadsheet work and gaining high-quality, evidence-based insights to help inform mission-aligned decisions.

title: Build and Secure MCP Services on Cloud Run
description: This course equips Application Developers, Cloud Architects, and DevSecOps engineers with the skills to architect, deploy, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Cloud Run. Learners will implement zero-trust security perimeters using Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) to safely connect Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform agents to internal enterprise data.

title: Google AI Essentials
description: Enhance your productivity across all roles and industries with essential AI skills. This course teaches you how to leverage AI to generate ideas and content, assist with research and organization, and speed up daily tasks like drafting email responses. Learn directly from Google AI experts how to use AI responsibly and earn a certificate upon completion.

title: Google Prompting Essentials
description: Unlock AI's full potential. Google Prompting Essentials teaches you how to give clear, specific instructions to generative AI tools, known as prompting, to maximize their benefits. Learn 5 easy steps in under 10 hours, with no prior experience required. You'll gain essential prompting skills to save time, uncover powerful insights, and tackle complex projects. Learn to use AI responsibly and build a reusable prompt library. Taught by AI experts at Google, this course offers a certificate upon completion.

title: Technical Support Fundamentals
description: Gain essential skills in Information Technology, including computer hardware, the Internet, software, troubleshooting, and customer service. This foundational course introduces you to the multifaceted world of IT, providing a broad overview of topics within this field. This is the first course in the IT Support Specialist Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level IT Support Specialist role.

title: The Bits and Bytes of Computer Networking
description: Discover the fundamentals of modern networking technologies and protocols, including cloud computing, practical applications, and network troubleshooting. This comprehensive course prepares you with essential computer networking skills. This is the second course in the Google IT Support Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an IT support role.

title: Operating Systems and You: Becoming a Power User
description: Explore operating systems, learn to manage software, users, and configure hardware through video lectures, demonstrations, and hands-on practice. This course provides critical IT support skills. This is the third course in the Google IT Support Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an IT Support Specialist role.

title: System Administration and IT Infrastructure Services
description: Gain essential skills in systems administration to confidently manage reliable computer systems in multi-user environments. Explore critical infrastructure services that keep organizations running and delve into cloud management, configuring servers, and using industry tools to manage computers, user information, and productivity. This is the fourth course in the Google IT Support Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an IT support role.

title: IT Security: Defense against the digital dark arts
description: Discover essential IT security concepts, tools, and best practices to safeguard data and systems. This course introduces threats and attacks, encryption algorithms, and the three As of information security: authentication, authorization, and accounting. Explore network security solutions, from firewalls to Wifi encryption, and learn to integrate a culture of security into your organization or team. This is the fifth course in the Google IT Support Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level IT support role.

title: Foundations: Data, Data, Everywhere
description:
Discover the power of data analytics and how it helps organizations improve processes, 
identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. This hands-on course introduces key 
data analytics topics and provides practical ways to accomplish common tasks using 
industry-standard tools. This is the first course in the Google Data Analytics Certificate, 
a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Ask Questions to Make Data-Driven Decisions
description:
Learn how to use data analytics knowledge to ask effective questions, make data-driven 
decisions, and meet stakeholders’ needs. Learn hands-on ways to accomplish common data 
analytics tasks from data analysts at Google. This is the second course in the Google Data 
Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Prepare Data for Exploration
description:
Learn how to effectively use spreadsheets and SQL for data extraction, organization, and 
protection. Get practical tips from data analysts at Google who provide hands-on ways to 
accomplish common tasks with industry-standard tools and helpful resources. This is the third 
course in the Google Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an 
introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Process Data from Dirty to Clean
description:
Learn how to to check and clean data using spreadsheets and SQL. Verify and report cleaning 
results, guided by Google data analysts who provide hands-on tasks with essential tools. 
No previous experience is necessary to build your understanding. This is the fourth course 
in the Google Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an 
introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Analyze Data to Answer Questions
description:
Apply your data analytics knowledge to real-world scenarios. Learn to organize and format 
data using spreadsheets and SQL, perform complex calculations, and leverage formulas, 
functions, and SQL queries for effective analysis. This is the fifth course in the Google 
Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level data 
analyst role.

title: Share Data Through the Art of Visualization
description:
Visualize and present your data findings effectively. This course shows how data visualizations, 
like visual dashboards, bring data to life. Explore Tableau, a data visualization platform, 
to create impactful presentations. Get instruction from Google data analysts, including 
hands-on activities, to equip you with essential data visualization skills. This is the sixth 
course in the Google Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an 
introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Introduction to Data Analysis Using Python
description:
This course is the seventh course in the Google Data Analytics Certificate. 
The Python programming language is a powerful tool for data analysis. 
In this course, you’ll learn the basic concepts of Python programming 
and how data professionals use Python on the job. You'll explore concepts 
such as object-oriented programming, variables, data types, functions, 
conditional statements, loops, and data structures.

Google employees who currently work in the field will guide you through 
this course by providing hands-on activities that simulate relevant tasks, 
sharing examples from their day-to-day work, and helping you enhance your 
data analytics skills to prepare for your career.

Learners who complete this certificate program will be equipped to apply 
for introductory-level jobs as data analysts. No previous experience is 
necessary.

title: Google Data Analytics Capstone: Complete a case study
description:
Prepare for the data analyst job application process by completing a case study to 
demonstrate your analytical skills. You will ask questions, prepare, process, analyze, 
visualize, and act on data. This is the eighth course in the Google Data Analytics 
Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level data analyst role.

title: Foundations of Project Management
description: Learn foundational project management terminology and a get deeper understanding of a project manager's role and responsibilities. This course helps you discover the foundational skills you'd need to land an introductory-level project management roles. This is the first course in the Google Project Management Certificate program, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level project manager role.

title: Project Initiation: Starting a Successful Project
description: Set your project up for success through strong project initiation. Learn to determine benefits and costs, set measurable goals, manage scope, and define success criteria. You will gain skills in stakeholder analysis, RACI charts, and developing a project charter. This is the second course in the Google Project Management Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level project manager role.

title: Project Planning: Putting It All Together
description: Plan and manage projects with confidence by learning to make accurate time estimates, set milestones, and build effective budgets. Discover how to identify and manage project risks and draft comprehensive communication plans. This is the third course in the Google Project Management Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level project manager role.

title: Project Execution: Running the Project
description: Gain essential skills in project execution and closing. Learn to track, manage, and communicate changes, dependencies, and risks effectively. Explore quality management, measure customer satisfaction, and implement continuous improvement. Prioritize and present data to inform decisions, strengthen leadership skills, and manage team dynamics. Discover tools for effective communication, meeting facilitation, and project status updates. Examine the project closing process and documentation. This is the fourth course in the Google Project Management Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level project manager role.

title: Agile Project Management
description: Discover how to apply Agile project management and the Scrum framework to drive value-driven delivery strategies. Learn to build and refine a Product Backlog, organize Scrum events, and coach Agile teams effectively. This course teaches essential skills for leading successful projects and navigating Agile roles. This is the fifth course in the Google Project Management Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an introductory-level project manager role.

title: Capstone: Applying Project Management in the Real World
description: Apply project management knowledge and skills in real-world scenarios. Develop a portfolio of project management artifacts demonstrating your ability to manage stakeholders and teams, organize plans, and communicate project details. This capstone course provides hands-on activities simulating common project management tasks, guided by Google employees. This is the sixth course in the Google Project Management Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level project management role.

title: Foundations of Cybersecurity
description:
Learn about the foundations of Cybersecurity. This course introduces you to the field, explaining its importance in 
business, and exploring the responsibilities and skills of an entry-level cybersecurity analyst. Google employees guide you 
through interactive videos and hands-on activities to build your skills. This is the first course in the Google Cybersecurity 
Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Play It Safe: Manage Security Risks
description:
Learn to apply frameworks and controls, identify risk management steps, and explore common threats and vulnerabilities. 
You'll analyze Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) data, use playbooks to respond to threats, and practice 
performing security audits. This is the second course in the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, a series designed to prepare 
you for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Connect and Protect: Networks and Network Security
description:
Discover how to secure networks and protect valuable information from cyber attacks. You'll gain essential skills in 
recognizing network-level vulnerabilities and implementing security measures like firewalls and virtual private networks. 
This course builds on foundational cybersecurity topics. This is the third course in the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, 
a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Tools of the Trade: Linux and SQL
description:
Advance your cybersecurity skills by learning how to use Linux and SQL for real-world analyst tasks. Learn to navigate 
file systems with Bash, authenticate users, and communicate with databases. Google experts provide hands-on activities 
simulating common cybersecurity scenarios to build your practical skills. This is the fourth course in the Google Cybersecurity 
Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Assets, Threats, and Vulnerabilities
description:
Develop an attacker mindset and learn tactics to stay ahead of security breaches. Explore assets, threats, and 
vulnerabilities, understanding how organizations protect valuable information and mitigate risk with security controls. 
This is the fifth course in the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level 
cybersecurity role.

title: Sound the Alarm: Detection and Response
description:
Learn more about incident detection and response. Define a security incident, explain the incident response lifecycle, 
and analyze network communications to detect security incidents using packet sniffing tools. Explore investigation processes 
and practice using IDS and SIEM tools. Google cybersecurity employees will guide you through hands-on activities. This is 
the sixth course in the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level cybersecurity 
role.

title: Automate Cybersecurity Tasks with Python
description:
Automate cybersecurity tasks and develop foundational Python programming skills. You'll learn data types, variables, 
conditional and iterative statements, functions, and work with libraries and modules. This is the seventh course in the 
Google Cybersecurity Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Put It to Work: Prepare for Cybersecurity Jobs
description:
Enhance your cybersecurity decision-making and incident escalation skills, crucial for informing and influencing 
stakeholders within an organization. This course also helps you develop ethical operational practices and explore the 
cybersecurity community. You will prepare for job applications by writing a resume and cover letter, and complete practice 
interviews. This is the eighth and final course in the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, a series designed to prepare you 
for an entry-level cybersecurity role.

title: Foundations of Digital Marketing and E-commerce
description:

channels. Explore entry-level jobs in digital marketing and e-commerce, identifying key roles and functions. 
Learn about the marketing funnel and how it shapes the customer journey. Google employees guide you with 
hands-on activities, simulating common tasks. This is the first course in the Google Digital Marketing & 
E-commerce Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level role.

title: Attract and Engage Customers with Digital Marketing
description:
Hone your digital marketing skills to attract and engage customers online. 
Learn search engine optimization (SEO), search engine marketing (SEM), and 
display advertising to increase website traffic and reach potential customers. 
Apply strategies and tools to build business awareness and understand customer 
needs. This is the second course in the Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce 
Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level digital marketing 
and e-commerce role.

to prepare you for an entry-level digital marketing and e-commerce role.

title: Think Outside the Inbox: Email Marketing
description:
Boost your outreach by learning to create and execute successful email marketing campaigns.

to drive engagement and loyalty. Google employees guide you with hands-on activities simulating 
real-world tasks. This is the fourth course in the Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificate, 
a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level digital marketing and e-commerce role.

title: Assess for Success: Marketing Analytics and Measurement
description:
Gain essential marketing analytics skills to measure, manage, and analyze campaign

plans, set performance goals, and adjust budgets based on key metrics and A/B test results. 
This is the fifth course in the Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificate, a series 
designed to prepare you for an entry-level Digital Marketing & E-commerce role.

title: Make the Sale: Build, Launch, and Manage E-commerce Stores
description:
Launch your online selling journey. Build a Shopify e-commerce store, add product listings, 
and master customer outreach through advertisements and campaigns. This course explores how 
businesses and individuals sell products online using popular platforms. Google employees 
guide you through hands-on activities simulating common digital marketing and e-commerce tasks, 
showing you essential tools and resources. This is the sixth course in the Google Digital Marketing 
& E-commerce Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level digital marketing 
and e-commerce role.

title: Satisfaction Guaranteed: Develop Customer Loyalty Online
description:
Discover how to build customer loyalty in e-commerce and develop strong client relationships 
through effective strategies and practical tools. This course demonstrates your ability to deliver 
a successful e-commerce strategy, enhancing your professional development skills. This is the 
seventh course in the Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificate, a series designed to 
prepare you for an entry-level digital marketing and e-commerce role.

title: Foundations of User Experience (UX) Design
description: Discover how to create usable, enjoyable, and accessible product interactions. Learn to empathize with users, define pain points, ideate design solutions, and create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups. This is the first course in the User Experience (UX) Design Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX designer role.

description: Learn more about essential UX skills like empathy, defining user needs through problem statements, and generating diverse solutions. This course provides hands-on activities simulating real-world scenarios with Google UX designers and researchers as your instructors. This is the second course in the UX Design Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX design role.

You will modify low-fidelity designs based on research insights, simulating real-world UX design scenarios. This is the fourth course in the User Experience (UX) Design Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX designer role.

You'll conduct research, collect feedback, and share your designs with development teams, building a professional UX portfolio. description: Design impactful user interfaces for websites by learning to plan, create wireframes, and prototype designs for user feedback. Develop a professional UX portfolio with a new design project. This is the sixth course in the Google UX Design Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX designer role.

description: Develop a compelling UX portfolio and prepare to apply for UX jobs. Demonstrate the skills you've gained through this program, including how to empathize with users, define pain points, create design solutions, wireframes, prototypes, and test designs. This is the seventh course in a program designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX designer role.

title: Build Wireframes and Low-Fidelity Prototypes
description: Create storyboards, paper wireframes, and digital low-fidelity prototypes using Figma. This course includes hands-on activities simulating real-world UX design scenarios. This is the third course in the Google UX Design Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level UX designer role.

title: Google Agile Essentials
description:
Get Started with Agile Project Management: Whether you're leading projects now, want to lead them in the future, or are simply curious about project management, Google Agile Essentials provides the skills and confidence to bring order to your work and deliver results faster – all in under 10 hours.
Essential skills you'll gain:
  
    Prioritize key tasks for maximum impact
    Utilize Scrum artifacts for effective project tracking
    Apply Agile methodologies in real-world scenarios
    Speed up, organize, and amplify project delivery
    Efficiently prioritize, track, and deliver projects
  

Taught by Google experts: Learn valuable and practical project management skills through a curriculum designed by Google employees with decades of experience.
Earn a certificate: Upon completing this self-paced course, you’ll receive a certificate from Google to share with your network and potential employers, demonstrating your valuable skills.

title: Foundations of Business Intelligence
description:
Uncover the importance of business intelligence and explore essential BI 
tools used on the job. Develop skills to help organizations access and utilize 
data for growth and improvement through hands-on activities and engaging content, 
created and taught by Google experts. This is the first course in the Google Business 
Intelligence Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level 
business intelligence professional role.

title: The Path to Insights: Data Models and Pipelines
description:
Design and analyze data models and databases, and learn essential extract, 
transform, load (ETL) processes to prepare data for business analysis and goals. 
Engage in hands-on activities simulating job tasks, guided by Google BI 
professionals. This is the second course in the Google Business Intelligence 
Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level business 
intelligence role.

title: Decisions, Decisions: Dashboards and Reports
description:
Advance your analytical capabilities. This course guides you through applying 
stakeholder needs, creating impactful BI visuals, and designing effective reporting 
tools, including interactive dashboards. You will learn to monitor data and answer 
critical business questions over time. This is the third course in the Google 
Business Intelligence Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for a business 
intelligence role.

title: Foundations of Data Science
description:
Begin your journey into advanced data analytics and discover how data professionals leverage powerful techniques like data storytelling, statistics, and machine learning to drive business decisions. 
This course explores the role of data professionals in the workplace and introduces the PACE (Plan, Analyze, Construct, Execute) project workflow, providing hands-on activities and real-world examples to enhance your data analytics skills. 
This is the first of seven courses in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level data scientist or advanced-level data analyst role.

title: Go Beyond the Numbers: Translate Data into Insights
description:
Create compelling data stories by practicing exploratory data analysis and creating effective data visualizations to communicate key insights. Google employees guide you with hands-on activities and real-world examples, 
helping you build essential data analytics skills for your career. This is the third course in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an advanced data analytics role.

title: The Power of Statistics
description:
Uncover how data professionals utilize statistics to analyze data, gain key insights, and communicate findings effectively. This course explores descriptive and inferential statistics, probability, sampling, confidence intervals, 
hypothesis testing, and Python for statistical analysis. Google employees provide hands-on activities, sharing real-world examples to enhance your data analytics skills for your career. This is the fourth course in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an advanced data analytics role.

title: Regression Analysis: Simplify Complex Data Relationships
description:
This is the fourth course in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate. Data professionals use regression analysis to discover the relationships between different variables in a dataset and identify key factors that affect business performance. In this course, you’ll practice modeling variable relationships. You'll learn about different methods of data modeling and how to use them to approach business problems. You’ll also explore methods such as linear regression, analysis of variance (ANOVA), and logistic regression.
Google employees who currently work in the field will guide you through this course by providing hands-on activities that simulate relevant tasks, sharing examples from their day-to-day work, and helping you enhance your data analytics skills to prepare for your career.
Learners who complete the eight courses in this program will have the skills needed to apply for data science and advanced data analytics jobs. This certificate assumes prior knowledge of foundational analytical principles, skills, and tools covered in the Google Data Analytics Certificate.

title: The Nuts and Bolts of Machine Learning
description:
Learn how machine learning uses algorithms and statistics to find patterns in data, helping professionals solve complex problems and make accurate predictions. 
Learn about supervised and unsupervised machine learning, and apply models like Naive Bayes, decision tree, and random forest. This is the sixth course in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an advanced data analytics role.

title: Google Advanced Data Analytics Capstone
description:
Prepare to apply your data analysis expertise to real business challenges. This final course offers an optional capstone project to develop data-driven insights. You'll put your skills to work through hands-on activities, 
and will be able to share examples from your learning experience to enhance your skills for a career. This is the seventh course in the Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an advanced data analytics role.

title: Crash Course on Python
description: Learn Python programming foundations, and apply basic Python syntax, use code editors, and write simple programs. Gain hands-on experience through interactive exercises and real-world examples, combining knowledge to solve complex programming problems. This is the first course in the Google IT Automation with Python Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an IT support specialist role.

title: Using Python to Interact with the Operating System
description: Learn to execute Python locally, organize code across files, read and write various file types, and utilize subprocesses and input streams. Develop Bash scripts and regular expressions, essential tools for system work. This course also covers automatic testing and setting up your developer environment. This is the second course in the Google IT Automation with Python Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level IT Support Specialist role.

title: Introduction to Git and GitHub
description: Discover how to track code and configuration file versions using Git, a popular version control system. You will also learn to set up a GitHub account to create remote repositories, understand Git's core functionality, and explore advanced features like branches and merging. This is the third course in the Google IT Automation with Python Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an IT Support Specialist role.

title: Troubleshooting and Debugging Techniques
description: Equip yourself with practical tools to identify and solve real-world IT problems. This course explores diverse strategies for tackling common pitfalls in code and IT infrastructure, applying these approaches to scenarios involving system issues and programs. This is the fourth course in the Google IT Automation with Python Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level IT Support Specialist role.

title: Configuration Management and the Cloud
description: In this course, learners will unlock the potential of automation for computer fleet management. This course provides a solid foundation in automation techniques, offering a pathway to becoming a versatile IT professional prepared to launch and support modern cloud based applications and systems. This course covers the art of automating computer deployment and management in a cloud-based environment, including the configuration of virtual machines using Puppet and managing infrastructure resources through orchestration tools like Terraform and command-line interfaces (CLIs). Learners will also explore how to define Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) and implement monitoring and actionable alerting systems to swiftly address issues. They’ll also gain expertise in incident management and recovery, including rollbacks, redundancy, and creating disaster recovery plans.

title: Automating Real-World Tasks with Python
description: Prepare to apply comprehensive IT automation skills learned throughout this program. This course challenges you with real-world scenarios in Qwiklabs, where you will use multiple abilities at once, including external Python modules like PIL and data serialization for APIs. This is the sixth and final course in the Google IT Automation with Python Certificate, a series designed to prepare you for an entry-level IT support role.

title: Accelerate Your Job Search with AI
description:
Enhance your job search with AI. This course provides practical strategies and leverages AI tools like Gemini and NotebookLM. Discover valuable skills, create a personalized job search plan, manage applications, and practice for interviews. You'll build a personalized job search portfolio including a resume and career identity statement to impress employers. No prior AI experience is needed.
This course is optional and has been added to Google Career Certificates to support graduates with their job search. To mark your completion, please complete the graded quiz at the beginning of this course.

title: Google People Management Essentials
description:
Ever wondered what makes a great people manager? In Google People Management Essentials, you’ll learn the skills required to become a confident, effective manager. Designed by The Google School for Leaders, this program distills decades of Google’s management research into actionable insights on how to build high-performing teams.  
Through hands-on activities and advice from over a dozen managers at Google, you'll learn to set clear goals, develop coaching skills, drive business results, and leverage AI as a management tool.
Whether you're an aspiring leader or already managing a team, you’ll leave this course with the practical skills to drive results and build a team where people can thrive. Upon completion, you'll earn a professional certificate from Google.
In this program, you’ll apply Google’s proven management research insights through hands-on activities that simulate real-world management challenges. You'll practice techniques like applying the SBI feedback model, and goal-setting using the SMART goal framework, gaining experience in coaching, delegation, and navigating difficult conversations. By utilizing these tools and exploring AI strategies for day-to-day management tasks, you’ll leave with an actionable plan to help you build a high-performing team.

title: AI Fundamentals
description:
Ever feel like AI is moving too fast to keep up? In this course, you’ll 
be introduced to the evergreen fundamentals of working with AI, its strengths 
and limitations. You’ll learn how to give AI clear and effective instructions, 
called prompts, and how to use AI responsibly by maintaining a “human-in-the-loop” 
approach.

title: AI for Brainstorming and Planning
description: Need to get a new project off the ground? In this course, you’ll gain practical experience streamlining the creative process and turning abstract ideas into detailed, actionable projects. You’ll learn how to brainstorm new ideas, evaluate them against common frameworks, and refine project timelines by prompting Gemini to investigate missing risks and dependencies. Finally, you’ll create a centralized project hub in NotebookLM to keep your team informed and aligned.

title: AI for Research and Insights
description: Struggling to get up to speed on complex topics? In this course, you’ll learn how to use AI as your strategic research partner to learn faster and make more informed decisions. You’ll start by using Gemini Deep Research to scour dozens of sources in minutes and turn those findings into compelling visual reports. Next, you’ll learn how to upload diverse sources—like PDFs and videos—into NotebookLM to generate instant, actionable summaries. Finally, you’ll use meta-prompting techniques to build a custom Gem to simulate an expert persona that tests your ideas and helps you gain new perspectives.

title: AI for Writing and Communicating
description:
Spending too much time refining your communications? In this course, you’ll 
learn how to use AI as your writing partner, instantly turning notes into clear 
messages that can be adapted for any group to achieve greater clarity and influence 
in the workplace. You’ll learn how to turn a raw meeting transcript into a concise 
summary with a clear table of action items using Gemini in Google Meet, and anticipate 
feedback by prompting Gemini to critique your work from different perspectives. 
You’ll also learn to instantly adapt your communications for different audiences 
with Gemini Canvas and build your confidence communicating your talking points using 
Gemini Live.

title: AI for Content Creation
description:
Ready to bring your creative ideas to life? In this course, you’ll learn how to use AI as your creative partner to 
generate, refine, and critique creative assets. You’ll manage the entire creative workflow, from initial concept to polished 
asset, with AI. You’ll brainstorm ideas and bring them to life with image and video generation models in Gemini. 
You’ll enhance your presentations with Gemini in Google Slides, and discover how to use Gemini as a "creative director" 
to develop design guidelines and produce engaging work.

title: AI for Data Analysis
description:
Are the answers you need buried in a dataset you can't decipher? In this course, you’ll learn how to use AI as your analytical partner to transform unstructured data into clear, actionable insights. 
You’ll use Gemini to identify success metrics for a project and practice converting messy data into a structured table you can actually analyze. You’ll also learn how to transform everyday words into powerful spreadsheet formulas and create compelling charts using Gemini in Google Sheets to make smarter, data-driven decisions.

title: AI for App Building
description:
Wish you could build a tool to make your workday a little easier, but don’t know where to start?  This 
course teaches you how to build with AI by vibe coding, the process of developing code using natural language. 
You’ll start by analyzing your professional workflow to identify an opportunity where a custom AI tool can make 
the biggest impact. Then, you’ll build an app to solve that exact challenge and learn the common pitfalls of 
vibe coding to ensure you are developing responsibly. Show off your advanced AI skills by sharing your app 
and testing it at work.

This path will equip you with the skills to effectively integrate Gemini into your BigQuery workflows, enabling you to create powerful, data-driven applications.

title: AI Boost Bites: Your Edge in the AI-Powered World
description: In just 10 minutes per session, you'll discover how Google's own experts wield AI tools like Gemini, Gemini for Workspace, Gemini Notebook, and AI Studio. These aren't just theories; they're battle-tested strategies for content creation, market intelligence, and solving real-world business challenges. Each "Bite" comes with a hands-on challenge, urging you to apply what you've learned immediately. This isn't just learning; it's active transformation, equipping you with the practical AI fluency essential for today’s competitive landscape. Unleash your potential and redefine what's possible with Google’s AI tools.

title: Google Cloud AI Infrastructure
description: This learning path, designed for intermediate to advanced technical learners, offers on-demand courses to specialize in AI Infrastructure on Google Cloud. You'll gain the knowledge and skills to design and deploy high-performance AI/ML solutions using Google Cloud's AI Hypercomputer, GPUs, TPUs, Compute, and Google Kubernetes Engine. Optimize every layer of your AI Infrastructure solutions, from storage and networking to orchestration and best practices, to redefine what's possible with Google AI Infrastructure.

title: Gemini for Government
description: This learning path for Gemini for Government is designed to provide a comprehensive introduction to this AI-powered suite of tools, which is an evolution of Gemini Enterprise. This training is tailored towards frontline workers and focuses on the practical application of key components like Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Code Assist. The learning path is designed to be modular, allowing users to select the courses most relevant to their roles and responsibilities.

title: Practicing Zero Trust
description: This learning path showcases many of the products and skills needed to amplify zero trust capabilities in Google Cloud. From securing end points, proving trusted relationships or understanding how to build limited roles, this path will give you experience in applying zero trust principles.

title: Google DeepMind: AI Research Foundations
description: Google DeepMind’s AI Research Foundations curriculum will deepen your understanding of the AI technologies behind language models like Google Gemini, and will teach you how to build and fine-tune modern language models from the ground up. It is designed for university students and community learners who are proficient in python, and studying computer science, math, physics or other technical subjects.

title: Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience
description: This learning path teaches you to transform customer service using Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX).  It provides a comprehensive overview of frameworks, principles, and content to build virtual agents that leverage generative features like human-like conversational flows, multimodal support, and real-time knowledge assistance.

title: Agentic AI on Google Cloud
description: This learning path, "Agentic AI on Google Cloud," guides learners through the principles, development, and deployment of intelligent multi-agent systems. The content focuses on leveraging key Google Cloud technologies, including an introduction to Gemini Enterprise, and practical skills in building and securing multi-agent architectures using the Agent Development Kit (ADK). Upon completion, learners will be able to accelerate knowledge exchange, integrate with enterprise databases, and deploy secure, advanced AI agent solutions on Google Cloud.

title: Inference on TPUs
description: This training aims to equip developers with the essential skills to design and implement efficient AI inference solutions using Google Cloud's specialized hardware and popular open-source frameworks. It will enable them to optimize performance and cost for their machine learning applications. Ultimately, learners will be proficient in leveraging GKE, Cloud TPUs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, and Keras for scalable AI inference deployments.

title: Fundamentals of Agent Development Kit (ADK)
description: This learning path explores the evolution of AI agents that move beyond text generation to autonomous execution using Agent Development Kit (ADK). You will learn how to build and configure agents using Python and YAML, progressing from basic setups to sophisticated assistants with advanced planning and structured output capabilities.

title: Develop Agents with Agent Development Kit (ADK)
description: Develop agents using Agent Development Kit (ADK) that can plan, reason, and execute tasks. You’ll learn how to set up your environment, configure your agent logic, add tools and memory, and learn about protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP). Complete the Engineer AI Agents with Agent Development Kit (ADK) hands-on lab to earn a skill badge.  Explore other paths in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) series.

title: Introduction to Agents and Google’s Agent Ecosystem
description: Gain a foundational understanding of AI agents, from their core architecture to their real-world business impact. Cover the essentials of "what is an agent," understand Google Cloud's unified stack for agent development, and gain practical experience by creating your first Gemini Enterprise application to earn a skill badge. Participants will acquire practical skills in utilizing Gemini Notebook for deriving insights from complex documents and building sophisticated, multi-agent customer experiences with CX Agent Studio. By the end of the path, learners will be equipped to implement secure, AI-powered solutions that enhance organizational productivity and streamline customer interactions.

This curriculum masters critical domains including advanced routing, load balancing, and network security, while leveraging specialized tools like Network Connectivity Center, Terraform, and Network Observability to manage complex hybrid architectures. By integrating GKE IP management and dedicated bridges for AWS and Azure professionals, the path equips engineers to design and automate a high-performance, resilient network fabric that supports modern, distributed workloads across any cloud.

Connect and operationalize agents across enterprise ecosystems. Complete the Deploy an Agent with Agent Development Kit challenge lab to earn a skill badge. Explore other paths in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) series.

title: Extend Agent Capabilities with Agent Development Kit (ADK)
description: This training guides the transition from building basic, stateless responders to developing sophisticated LLM agents capable of maintaining user context through session state. It focuses on equipping these agents with real-world tools—such as web searching, code execution, and database querying—to transform them into functional assistants that take action. Finally, this path emphasizes production readiness by implementing callbacks and guardrails to ensure every interaction remains safe, monitored, and reliable.

Within this path, you will find courses on generative AI, specific modules to help you master our suite of Google Workspace products, as well as videos with quick tips to develop specific skills or tasks. AI presents an immediate opportunity to build capacity, enabling governments to serve their communities faster and more equitably. This path is your first step in unlocking that potential. This pathway assumes basic knowledge of Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, etc.); however, the Google Workspace Essentials course is available if a more introductory course is needed.

This path teaches you to design workflow-based routing and deploy your solutions via Agent Runtime. Explore other paths in the Gemini Enterprise Agent Ready (GEAR) series.

title: Building Realtime Pipelines in Cloud Data Fusion
description: In addition to batch pipelines, Data Fusion also allows you to create realtime pipelines, that can process events as they are generated. Currently, realtime pipelines execute using Apache Spark Streaming on Cloud Managed Service for Spark clusters. In this lab you you will learn how to build a streaming pipeline using Data Fusion.

title: Introduction to Computer Use with Gemini
description: In this lab, you build an autonomous web agent that uses the Gemini API in Agent Platform and Playwright to automate manual browser tasks. By implementing a continuous agent loop, you enable the model to observe the UI through screenshots and execute complex, multi-step actions like clicking and typing until a specific goal is achieved.

title: Design Industry-Specific Structured Prompts in Google AI Studio
description: In this lab, you learn how to navigate the user interface, experiment with sample prompts and AI models, and understand the fundamental concepts of structured prompt design.

title: Getting Started with MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud
description: In this lab you will provision a MongoDB Atlas database and deploy a MEAN Cloud Run app

title: Streamline Data Science Workflows with the Colab Enterprise Agent
description: In this lab, you will use the Data Science Agent in Colab Enterprise to build a neural network model to predict media sales.

title: Datadog: Getting started with the Helm Chart
description: In this lab, you will learn how to use the Datadog Helm Chart.

title: Getting Started with Elasticsearch on Google Cloud
description: In this lab you will create a simple Elasticsearch deployment leveraging Google Cloud Platform.

title: Exploring the Public Cryptocurrency Datasets Available in BigQuery
description: In this hands-on lab you’ll learn how to use BigQuery to explore the cryptocurrency public datasets now available. This is a challange lab, and you are required to complete some simple SQL statements.

title: Connecting Cisco SD-WAN to Google Cloud using Cloud onRamp Automation
description: Cisco SD-WAN Cloud OnRamp allows you to simplify and secure connectivity to cloud applications and public cloud

title: Using Elastic Stack to Monitor Google Cloud
description: In this lab you will learn how to use the Elastic Stack to monitor Google Cloud Platform.

title: Configure Cloud Armor Hierarchical Security Policies
description: In this lab, you learn how to configure and deploy Google Cloud Armor Hierarchical Security Policies and explore Cloud Armor Enterprise tier features.

title: Configure Cloud Armor for GKE
description: Learn how to configure Google Cloud Armor web application firewall (WAF) security policies and attach them to GKE Gateway API resources to protect containerized workloads against web-based attacks.

title: Configure Native Bucket IP Filtering in Cloud Storage
description: In this lab, you secure Cloud Storage buckets using Native Bucket IP Filtering to enforce network-level controls.

title: Enable Native Exchange Messaging and Clustering with Aeron
description: This lab shows you how to run a basic deployment of Aeron Cluster to demonstrate high availability deterministic message handling, node to node communication, failover and recovery, admin commands and basic messaging.

title: Enforce Platform Governance Policies on GKE
description: In this lab, you enforce cost boundaries (Spot instances) and access governance (Validating Webhooks) for high-performance workloads, while observing on-demand autoscaling on GKE.

title: Execute Rolling Updates and GitOps on GKE
description: Learn how to perform imperative application lifecycle updates (Rolling Updates) and transition to declarative, automated resource optimization using GitOps (Config Sync) on GKE.

title: Getting Started with Splunk Cloud GDI on Google Cloud
description: A step-by-step guide through the process to configure multiple methods to ingest Google Cloud data into Splunk

title: Leveraging Verifiable Credentials and Zero-Knowledge Proofs with Sindri
description: Learn how to use the Sindri API to generate zero-knowledge proofs and use them with verifiable credentials.

title: Troubleshoot WAF Rules
description: Learn how to troubleshoot Google Cloud Armor Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, identify false positives using verbose logging, fine-tune preconfigured WAF rules with exclusions, and verify legitimate traffic flow.

title: Connect Apps Script Securely to Agent Platform
description: Learn how to securely connect a Google Apps Script project to Agent Platform using a Service Account with OAuth 2.0.

title: Create Views of Query Results Using bq CLI
description: This hands-on lab provides a quick introduction on how to create views of query results using the bq command-line tool.

title: Implement Automated Data Backups Using bq CLI
description: This hands-on lab provides a quick introduction on how to implement automated BigQuery data backups using scheduled queries with the bq command-line tool.

title: Implement Product Search Indexes for Marketing Using bq CLI
description: This hands-on lab provides a quick introduction on how to implement a search index in BigQuery using the bq command-line tool.

title: Leveraging NetApp Cloud Volume ONTAP Remote Caching Capabilities for EDA Workloads
description: In this lab you will learn how to leverage NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP remote caching for EDA workloads.

title: Migrate from Oracle to AlloyDB for PostgreSQL using Database Migration Service
description: In this lab, you migrate a database schema and data from Oracle to an AlloyDB for PostgreSQL cluster using the Database Migration Service Conversion Workspace (including code remediation) and a one-time migration job.

title: Route Datadog Monitoring Alerts to Google Cloud with Eventarc
description: In this lab, you will learn how to use the Datadog Monitoring with Google Eventarc.

title: YouTube Video Analysis with Gemini
description: In this lab, you will learn how to do direct analysis of publicly available YouTube videos with Gemini.

title: Configure Batch Transfers and Anywhere Cache in Cloud Storage
description: In this lab, you perform batch data transfers from a POSIX filesystem to Cloud Storage using an agent pool, and configure Cloud Storage Anywhere Cache for accelerated object access.

title: Configure Event-Driven Transfers with Storage Transfer Service
description: In this lab, you configure event-driven data transfers from AWS S3 to Cloud Storage and from Cloud Storage to Cloud Storage using Storage Transfer Service (STS), AWS SQS, and Cloud Pub/Sub event notifications.

title: Enhancing Google Cloud Network Security
description: Advancing your Google Cloud network security with VM-Series, Cloud IDS, and XSOAR.
